ruleLine: Permanent trumps: CQ > SQ > CJ > SJ > HJ > DJ (highest whatever the trump suit)

hint.bid: this length beats the standing bid
hint.pass: nothing you hold beats the standing bid
tutorial.trumps: Both black queens and all four jacks are the highest trumps whatever the trump suit. Believing only the trump suit is trump is the standard mistake.
tutorial.bid: You bid the LENGTH of your longest trump suit, not a target score. Below five you cannot bid, and at equal length clubs wins.
tutorial.follow: Trumps form their own suit. With hearts trump the club jack is a trump, so a club lead does not oblige it.
tutorial.rubber: A rubber counts DOWN from 24. The first side to reach zero wins it, and if the losers never left 24 it is a double victory.
